## Overview

**Henry** is one of the **Four Blood Brothers** — the knights who rose from the crowd at Aegon's trial to stand beside him in the **Judgment of Five**. He fought with Aegon, survived the brutal melee, and now serves as a commander in the new **Order of the Protectors**.

Known for his fire and unwavering faith in Aegon's cause. He carries the weight of the three champions who fell at their hands — warriors he once called brothers.

---

## Current Status

Separated from Aegon — tasked with rallying sympathetic knights in the outer territories. His passion makes him effective but also the most likely to be compromised.
